verdict: Yes, with a scent people remember. Isak Fragrances from Lucknow pitched perfumes on Shark Tank India Season 1 and got a deal. Indian buyers are spending more on fragrances, and D2C perfume brands have grown fast, but you'll need a strong nose or a good perfumer.
angle: Affordable, long-lasting perfumes inspired by popular scents sell well online. Testers, discovery kits and gifting are key to getting buyers to try a new brand. Kannauj and contract perfumers can supply oils.
